source:
An independent contractor who ekes out a living working for Hell's provincial government. His radio receiver kinda looks like a horn and his weapon of choice is a metal club, so many of the spirits he encounters refer to him as The Oni.

[Translated from the official website by [url=https://x.com/DistantValhalla/status/1727446485606834639]Steiner[/url]]
